specials.title: Red Dog Weekly Specials
specials.description:
Wednesday - Saturday Dinner Specials

Soup:
Irish Vegetable ... 6 (Cup) or 8 (bowl)
A combination of potatoes, leeks, carrots and celery
creates a classic vegetable soup with a smooth,
comforting texture.

Appetizer:
Smoked Trout Dip ... 16
This dip features smoked trout along with cream
cheese mixed with fresh herbs. Served with fried
pita bread.

Entrées:

Corned Beef and Cabbage ... 22
Tender and juicy corned beef brisket that’s
simmered with pickling spices, potatoes, cabbage,
and carrots. Served with spoon bread and house-
made horseradish sauce.

Louisiana Shrimp or Oyster Po Boy ... 18
Classic New Orleans sandwich served on toasted
French bread, with fried shrimp or fried oysters,
lettuce, tomato, and creamy remoulade sauce.

Pastrami Reuben Sandwich ... 20
Hot, hand-carved pastrami, tangy sauerkraut,
melted Swiss cheese, and Russian dressing on
grilled marbled rye bread.

Pasta Bolognese ... 18
Bolognese is a slowly cooked meat-based Italian
sauce rich and velvety served with al dente pasta
and crusty garlic bread.

Lunch Specials Friday and Saturday Only

Beer Battered Fish Sandwich ... 15
Cod, beer battered, served on a toasted brioche
bun with tarter sauce and coleslaw.

Jalapeño Popper Smashburger ... 16
Our signature beef blend smashed and grilled with
jalapeños, topped with havarti cheese on a toasted
brioche bun with bacon jam and a layer of cream
cheese, lettuce, tomato.

Cheesy Smashburger ... 14
Our signature beef blend grilled with thinly sliced on-
ions until hot and bubbly. Add American cheese, then
topped with mustard, dill pickles, lettuce and tomato.

Chili Cheese Smashburger ... 15
Our signature beef blend cheesy smash patty with
grilled onions topped with American cheese, a layer
of our housemade meaty chili, more American cheese, lettuce, and tomato
